name: 血誓倒计时
description: 血誓持续时间在飞段自己回合结束时减少，归零时解除（持续飞段的3个己方回合）
skillCode: var piece = context.rulePiece; var tag = piece.statusTags && piece.statusTags.find(function(t) { return t.type === 'blood-oath'; }); if (!tag) { piece.rules = (piece.rules || []).filter(function(r) { return r.id !== 'rule-blood-oath-tick'; }); return { success: false, message: '' }; } if (context.battle.turn.currentPlayerId !== tag.sourcePlayerId) return { success: false, message: '' }; tag.remainingTurns = (tag.remainingTurns !== undefined ? tag.remainingTurns : 3) - 1; if (tag.remainingTurns <= 0) { piece.statusTags = (piece.statusTags || []).filter(function(t) { return t.type !== 'blood-oath'; }); piece.rules = (piece.rules || []).filter(function(r) { return r.id !== 'rule-blood-oath-tick'; }); return { success: true, message: piece.name + '的血誓诅咒已解除' }; } return { success: true, message: piece.name + '的血誓诅咒还剩' + tag.remainingTurns + '回合（飞段视角）' };
